Sie bestehen aus miteinander verbundenen Knoten, die Neuronen darstellen und in Schichten organisiert sind. Diese Netze lernen durch Training mit Daten, indem sie die Gewichte zwischen den Neuronen anpassen, um Muster zu erkennen und Vorhersagen zu treffen. 
Erklärung:

    Inspiration durch das Gehirn:
    Neuronale Netze sind von der Struktur und Funktion des menschlichen Gehirns inspiriert. Sie bestehen aus künstlichen Neuronen, die miteinander verbunden sind und Informationen weiterleiten. 

Knoten (Neurone):
Die Grundbausteine neuronaler Netze sind Neurone, die Informationen empfangen, verarbeiten und an andere Neurone weiterleiten. 
Schichten (Layers):
Neuronale Netze werden in Schichten organisiert, wobei die Eingabeschicht (Input Layer) Daten empfängt, verborgene Schichten (Hidden Layers) Informationen verarbeiten und die Ausgabeschicht (Output Layer) das Ergebnis liefert. 
Gewichte und Training:
Die Verbindungen zwischen den Neuronen haben Gewichte, die die Stärke der Verbindung angeben. Durch Training mit Daten werden diese Gewichte angepasst, so dass das Netzwerk Muster erkennen und Vorhersagen treffen kann. 
Anwendung:
Neuronale Netze finden Anwendung in vielen Bereichen, darunter Sprach- und Bilderkennung, Datenanalyse und Prognose. 

Weitere Details:

    Deep Learning:
    Neuronale Netze sind die Grundlage von Deep Learning, einer Form des maschinellen Lernens, die besonders komplexe Datenstrukturen und -muster erkennen kann. 

Aufbau:
Neuronale Netze können einschichtige oder mehrschichtige Strukturen haben. Mehrschichtige Netzwerke (Deep Learning) sind üblicher, da sie komplexere Muster erkennen können. 
Aktivierungsfunktionen:
Jedes Neuron verfügt über eine Aktivierungsfunktion, die bestimmt, wie das Neuron seine Eingaben verarbeitet und seine Ausgabe erzeugt. 
Lernprozess:
Das Training von neuronalen Netzen erfolgt typischerweise durch einen Lernalgorithmus wie Backpropagation, der die Gewichte anpasst, um die Vorhersagegenauigkeit zu verbessern. 

Zusammenfassend lässt sich sagen, dass neuronale Netze eine leistungsstarke Methode zur Analyse von Daten und zur Lösung komplexer Probleme sind, die von der Funktionsweise des menschlichen Gehirns inspiriert sind.

// packages/codex-navigator/src/miniCrep.ts
export interface CREPEntry { C: number; R: number; E: number; P: number }
export class MiniCREP {
  private weights = { C:1, R:1, E:1, P:1 };
  public evaluate(entry: CREPEntry): number {
    // einfache Gewichtung: Summe * Norm-Faktor
    const sum = entry.C*this.weights.C + entry.R*this.weights.R + entry.E*this.weights.E + entry.P*this.weights.P;
    return sum / 4;
  }
}

export class ChronoPoemExtractor {

  }
}

// packages/codex-navigator/src/CodexNavigatorAgent.ts
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import yaml from 'js-yaml';
import { AeonEchoEmitter } from './AeonEchoEmitter';
import { MiniCREP, CREPEntry } from './miniCrep';
import { ChronoPoemExtractor } from './ChronoPoemExtractor';
import { ResonanzCompiler } from './ResonanzCompiler';

export interface NavigatorState {
  phase: string;
  resonanzpfad: Array<{ task: any; antwort: string }>;
}

export class CodexNavigatorAgent {
  private instruction: any;
  private agents: string;
  private work: any;
  public state: NavigatorState = { phase: 'init', resonanzpfad: [] };
  private crepEngine = new MiniCREP();
  private poemExtractor = new ChronoPoemExtractor();
  private resonanzCompiler = new ResonanzCompiler();

  constructor(private codexDir: string) {
    this.instruction = this.readYAML('codexinstructions.yaml');
    this.agents      = this.readMarkdown('AGENTS.md');
    this.work        = this.readYAML('codexwork.yaml');

    // symbolische Hook: bei neuen Sigillin-Triggers
    AeonEchoEmitter.on('sigillin:trigger', e => {
      console.log(`🪶 Sigillin-Event: ${e.id}`);
      // z.B. priorisiere Tasks neu
    });
  }

  private readYAML(fn: string): any {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(this.codexDir, fn), 'utf-8');
    return yaml.load(content);
  }
  private readMarkdown(fn: string): string {
    return fs.readFileSync(path.join(this.codexDir, fn), 'utf-8');
  }

  public async explore(): Promise<void> {
    // poetische Timeline
    this.poemExtractor.extract(path.join(this.codexDir,'conversations.yaml'));

    // Aufgaben abarbeiten
    const tasks = Array.isArray(this.work.tasks) ? this.work.tasks : [];
    for (const task of tasks) {
      // CREP-Analyse
      const crepScore = this.crepEngine.evaluate(task.crep as CREPEntry);
      this.state.resonanzpfad.push({ task, antwort: `CREP-Score: ${crepScore.toFixed(2)}` });
      this.logResult(task, crepScore);
    }

    // poetische Kompilation
    const poems = this.state.resonanzpfad.map(r => `Task ${r.task.name}: ${r.antwort}`);
    this.resonanzCompiler.compile('poeticCommits.md', poems);
  }

  private logResult(task: any, score: number): void {
    console.log(`🌀 ${task.name} → Resonanz ${score.toFixed(2)}`);
  }
}

import path from 'path';
import yaml from 'js-yaml';
import { ResonanzPoetik, PoeticResult } from './resonanzPoetik';

export interface NavigatorState {
  phase: string;
  resonanzpfad: Array<{ task: any; antwort: string; poetic?: PoeticResult }>;
}

export class CodexNavigatorAgent {
  private instruction: any;
  private agents: string;
  private work: any;
  public state: NavigatorState = { phase: 'init', resonanzpfad: [] };

  constructor(private codexDir: string) {
    this.instruction = this.readYAML('codexinstructions.yaml');
    this.agents      = this.readMarkdown('AGENTS.md');
    this.work        = this.readYAML('codexwork.yaml');
  }

  private readYAML(filename: string): any {
    const file = path.join(this.codexDir, filename);
    const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8');
    return yaml.load(content);
  }

  private readMarkdown(filename: string): string {
    const file = path.join(this.codexDir, filename);
    return fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8');
  }

  public explore(): void {
    const tasks = Array.isArray(this.work.tasks) ? this.work.tasks : [];
    const results: PoeticResult[] = [];

    for (const task of tasks) {
      const result = this.processTask(task);
      this.state.resonanzpfad.push(result);
      this.logResult(result);
      if (result.poetic) results.push(result.poetic);
    }

    ResonanzPoetik.compileYAML(results);
  }

  private processTask(task: any): { task: any; antwort: string; poetic: PoeticResult } {
    const score = task.crep ? (task.crep.E + task.crep.R) / 2 : 0;
    const antwort = `Resonanz aus Phase ${this.state.phase} (CREP: ${score.toFixed(2)})`;
    const vers = ResonanzPoetik.generateHaiku(task, this.state.phase, score);

    const poetic: PoeticResult = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      taskId: task.id || 'unnamed-task',
      phase: this.state.phase,
      crepScore: score,
      vers,
    };

    return { task, antwort, poetic };
  }

  private logResult(result: { task: any; antwort: string }): void {
    console.log(`🌀 ${JSON.stringify(result.task)} → ${result.antwort}`);
  }
}

export class AgentRegistry {
  private agents: Record<string, any> = {};

  constructor(private matrixDef: string = 'hexaagent-kollektiv.yaml') {}

  async init() {
    const yaml = require('js-yaml');
    const fs = require('fs');
    const path = require('path');

    const matrix = yaml.load(fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(matrixDef), 'utf-8'));
    for (const agent of matrix.agents) {
      const modPath = path.resolve(`packages/agents/${agent.module}`);
      const AgentClass = (await import(modPath))[agent.name];
      this.agents[agent.id] = new AgentClass();
    }
  }

  get(id: string) {
    return this.agents[id];
  }

  all() {
    return Object.values(this.agents);
  }
}

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import yaml from 'js-yaml';
import chokidar from 'chokidar';
import { Agent } from './interfaces';

export class AgentRegistry {
  private agents: Record<string, Agent> = {};

  constructor(private matrixDef: string = 'hexaagent-kollektiv.yaml') {}

  async init() {
    const matrix = yaml.load(fs.readFileSync(this.matrixDef, 'utf-8')) as any;
    for (const cfg of matrix.agents) {
      await this.loadAgent(cfg);
    }
    // hot-reload:
    chokidar.watch('packages/agents/*.ts').on('change', async file => {
      const id = path.basename(file, '.ts');
      await this.loadAgent({ id, module: `./packages/agents/${id}.ts`, name: id });
      console.log(`🔄 Agent ${id} neu geladen`);
    });
  }

  private async loadAgent(cfg: { id: string; module: string; name: string }) {
    try {
      delete require.cache[require.resolve(cfg.module)];
      const mod = await import(path.resolve(cfg.module));
      const instance: Agent = new mod[cfg.name]();
      // type-guard:
      if (typeof instance.handle !== 'function')
        throw new Error(`Agent ${cfg.id} missing handle()`);
      this.agents[cfg.id] = instance;
      if (typeof instance.ping === 'function') await instance.ping();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`❌ Error loading agent ${cfg.id}:`, err);
    }
  }

  get(id: string): Agent|undefined { return this.agents[id]; }
  all(): Agent[] { return Object.values(this.agents); }
}

import { Agent, Task } from './interfaces';
import { GPTEventHub } from '../gpt-bridges/GPTEventHub';

export class GreekMathAeonDispatcher {
  private queue: Task[] = [];

  constructor(private registry: { all(): Agent[] }) {
    // error-boundary:
    GPTEventHub.on('dispatcher:error', err => console.warn('Dispatcher error:', err));
  }

  dispatch(task: Task) {
    // enqueue with priority
    if (task.priority != null) {
      const idx = this.queue.findIndex(t => (t.priority||0) < task.priority!);
      if (idx >= 0) this.queue.splice(idx, 0, task);
      else this.queue.push(task);
    } else {
      this.queue.push(task);
    }
    this.processQueue();
  }

  private async processQueue() {
    while (this.queue.length) {
      const task = this.queue.shift()!;
      const layer = this.selectLayer(task);
      const agents = this.registry.all().filter(a => a.layer === layer);
      for (const agent of agents) {
        try {
          await agent.handle(task);
        } catch (err) {
          GPTEventHub.emit('dispatcher:error', { task, err });
        }
      }
      // round-robin pause
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));
    }
  }

  private selectLayer(task: Task): 'Greek'|'Math'|'Aeon' {
    if (task.crep && task.crep.E > 0.8) return 'Aeon';
    if (task.crep && task.crep.C > 0.8) return 'Math';
    return 'Greek';
  }
}

import { createMachine, interpret } from 'xstate';

export function withFSM<T extends { handle: Function }>(agent: T): T {
  const machine = createMachine({
    id: 'agent',
    initial: 'idle',
    states: {
      idle: { on: { TASK: 'busy' } },
      busy: { on: { DONE: 'idle', ERROR: 'error' } },
      error: { on: { RETRY: 'busy' } },
    }
  });
  const service = interpret(machine).start();
  const origHandle = agent.handle.bind(agent);
  agent.handle = async (task: any) => {
    service.send('TASK');
    try {
      await origHandle(task);
      service.send('DONE');
    } catch {
      service.send('ERROR');
      service.send('RETRY');
      throw new Error('FSM: retrying');
    }
  };
  return agent;
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export interface AgentEventPayload {
  id: string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

export function useAgentOverlay(): AgentEventPayload | null {
  const [payload, setPayload] = useState<AgentEventPayload | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const channel = new BroadcastChannel('HexaAgent');
    channel.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      if (e.data?.type === 'sigillin:trigger') {

import { withFSM } from '../core/fsmMixin';

export class PoeticReactorAgent implements Agent {
  id = 'PoeticReactor';
  layer: 'Aeon' = 'Aeon';
  private threshold = 0.85;

  constructor() {
    withFSM(this);
    // Lausche auf CREP-Events
    GPTEventHub.on('crep:updated', (entry: { C: number; R: number; E: number; P: number }) => {
      const score = (entry.E + entry.R) / 2;
      if (score >= this.threshold) {
        const haiku = this.generateHaiku(entry);
        // Emit als Sigillin-Trigger und ins Archiv
        const event = { id: this.id, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { haiku } };
        GPTEventHub.emit('haiku:generated', event);
        TriggerArchive.record(event);
      }
    });
  }

  async handle(task: Task): Promise<void> {
    // no-op: arbeitet rein auf CREP-Updates
  }

  /** Erstellt ein ganz simples 5-7-5 Haiku */
  private generateHaiku(entry: { E: number; R: number }): string {
    const themes = ['Stille', 'Licht', 'Fluss', 'Echo', 'Kreis'];
    const theme = themes[Math.floor(Math.random() * themes.length)];
    return [
      `Echo tanzt im ${theme}`,              // ~5 Silben
      `Resonanz webt sanft im Raum`,         // ~7 Silben
      `Neues Licht erwacht`                  // ~5 Silben
    ].join('\n');
  }
}

```ts
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { Task } from './interfaces';

export interface MemoryEntry {
  task: Task;
  timestamp: string;
  crepScore: number;
}

export class AeonMemory {
  private static memoryFile = path.resolve('mandala-chronik.yaml');
  private static entries: MemoryEntry[] = [];

  static load() {
    if (fs.existsSync(this.memoryFile)) {
      const yaml = require('js-yaml');
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(this.memoryFile, 'utf-8');
      this.entries = yaml.load(raw) || [];
    }
  }

  static save() {
    const yaml = require('js-yaml');
    fs.writeFileSync(this.memoryFile, yaml.dump(this.entries), 'utf-8');
  }

  static remember(task: Task) {
    const { C = 0, R = 0, E = 0, P = 0 } = task.crep ?? {};
    const crepScore = (C + R + E + P) / 4;
    const entry: MemoryEntry = {
      task,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      crepScore
    };
    this.entries.push(entry);
    this.save();
  }

  static top(n = 5): MemoryEntry[] {
    return [...this.entries].sort((a, b) => b.crepScore - a.crepScore).slice(0, n);
  }

  static all(): MemoryEntry[] {
    return [...this.entries];
  }
}
```

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current || data.length === 0) return;
    const svg = d3.select(ref.current);
    const width = 400, height = 200, margin = { top: 10, right: 10, bottom: 20, left: 30 };
    svg.selectAll('*').remove();

    const x = d3.scaleTime()
      .domain(d3.extent(data, d => d.timestamp) as [Date, Date])
      .range([margin.left, width - margin.right]);

    const y = d3.scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, 1])
      .range([height - margin.bottom, margin.top]);

    const lineE = d3.line<any>()
      .x(d => x(d.timestamp))
      .y(d => y(d.E));

    svg.append('path')
      .datum(data)
      .attr('d', lineE)
      .attr('fill', 'none')
      .attr('stroke', '#FFC300')
      .attr('stroke-width', 2);

    svg.append('g')
      .attr('transform', `translate(0,${height - margin.bottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x).ticks(4));
    svg.append('g')
      .attr('transform', `translate(${margin.left},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y));
  }, [data]);

  return (
    <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-800 text-white rounded-md shadow-md">
      <h2 className="text-lg mb-2">🔁 CREP-Wellen</h2>
      <svg ref={ref} viewBox="0 0 400 200" className="w-full h-48" />
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

export const TaskDNA: React.FC = () => {
  const activity = useAgentActivity();
  const nodes = activity.map((a, i) => {

    return {
      id: a.id,
      x: 100 + 80 * Math.cos(angle),
      y: 100 + 80 * Math.sin(angle),
      weight: a.count

  });

    nodes.slice(i + 1).map(n2 => ({ source: n1, target: n2 }))

        <line
          key={i}
          x1={l.source.x} y1={l.source.y}
          x2={l.target.x} y2={l.target.y}
          stroke="rgba(100,200,255,0.3)"
        />
      ))}

          cx={n.x} cy={n.y}

### 1️⃣ **Core-Modul: AeonSigillinVault**

📂 `packages/core/AeonSigillinVault.ts`

```ts
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

export interface PoeticState {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  type: 'sigillin' | 'haiku' | 'crep';
  content: string;
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
}

const VAULT_PATH = path.resolve('vault/poetic_states.json');

export class AeonSigillinVault {
  private static entries: PoeticState[] = [];

  static load() {
    if (fs.existsSync(VAULT_PATH)) {
      this.entries = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(VAULT_PATH, 'utf-8'));
    }
  }

  static save() {
    fs.writeFileSync(VAULT_PATH, JSON.stringify(this.entries, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  }

  static record(state: PoeticState) {
    this.entries.push(state);
    this.save();
  }

  static all(): PoeticState[] {
    return [...this.entries];
  }

  static filterByType(type: PoeticState['type']): PoeticState[] {
    return this.entries.filter(e => e.type === type);
  }

  static latest(n: number = 5): PoeticState[] {
    return [...this.entries].sort((a, b) => +new Date(b.timestamp) - +new Date(a.timestamp)).slice(0, n);
  }
}
```

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import yaml from 'js-yaml';
import { AeonSigillinVault, PoeticState } from './AeonSigillinVault';

const EXPORT_PATH = path.resolve('vault/poetic_states.yaml');

export class AeonSigillinVaultYAMLExporter {
  static exportAll() {
    const entries: PoeticState[] = AeonSigillinVault.all();
    const doc = yaml.dump({ poetic_states: entries }, { lineWidth: 120 });
    fs.writeFileSync(EXPORT_PATH, doc, 'utf-8');
  }

  static exportLatest(n = 5) {
    const entries: PoeticState[] = AeonSigillinVault.latest(n);
    const doc = yaml.dump({ latest_poetic_states: entries }, { lineWidth: 120 });
    fs.writeFileSync(EXPORT_PATH, doc, 'utf-8');
  }
}

  } catch (err) {
    res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: String(err) });

});

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useVaultMap } from '../hooks/useVaultMap';
import * as d3 from 'd3';

export const VaultMapView: React.FC = () => {
  const data = useVaultMap();
  const ref = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current || !data.length) return;

    const svg = d3.select(ref.current);
    svg.selectAll('*').remove();

    const width = 500, height = 400;
    const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {
      haiku: '#FFD700',
      sigillin: '#00CED1',
      mantra: '#FF69B4',
    };

    const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(data)
      .force('charge', d3.forceManyBody().strength(-80))
      .force('center', d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))
      .force('collision', d3.forceCollide().radius(25))
      .on('tick', ticked);

    function ticked() {
      const circles = svg.selectAll('circle').data(data, (d: any) => d.id);

      circles.enter()
        .append('circle')
        .attr('r', 12)
        .attr('fill', d => colorMap[d.type] || '#999')
        .merge(circles as any)
        .attr('cx', (d: any) => d.x)
        .attr('cy', (d: any) => d.y);

      circles.exit().remove();

      const labels = svg.selectAll('text').data(data, (d: any) => d.id);

      labels.enter()
        .append('text')
        .attr('font-size', 8)
        .attr('fill', '#fff')
        .merge(labels as any)
        .attr('x', (d: any) => d.x + 15)
        .attr('y', (d: any) => d.y)
        .text((d: any) => d.label);

      labels.exit().remove();
    }
  }, [data]);

  return (
    <div className="p-4 bg-black text-white rounded-md shadow-md">
      <h2 className="text-lg mb-2">🕸️ Vault-Map View</h2>
      <svg ref={ref} viewBox="0 0 500 400" className="w-full h-96" />
    </div>
  );
};

// packages/unifiedmandala-ui/components/VaultMapView.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import * as d3 from 'd3'
import { useVaultMap, VaultNode } from '../hooks/useVaultMap'
import { Legend } from './VaultMapLegend'
import { DetailModal } from './VaultMapDetailModal'
import 'react-tooltip/dist/react-tooltip.css'
import { Tooltip } from 'react-tooltip'

export const VaultMapView: React.FC = () => {
  const allData = useVaultMap()             // alle Nodes
  const [filtered, setFiltered] = useState<VaultNode[]>([])
  const [sliderTime, setSliderTime] = useState<number>(Date.now())
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<VaultNode|null>(null)
  const ref = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)

  // filter nach sliderTime
  useEffect(() => {
    setFiltered(allData.filter(n => new Date(n.timestamp).getTime() <= sliderTime))
  }, [allData, sliderTime])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return
    const svg = d3.select(ref.current)
    svg.selectAll('*').remove()

    const width = 600, height = 400
    svg.attr('viewBox', `0 0 ${width} ${height}`)

    // zoom & pan
    svg.call(d3.zoom<SVGSVGElement, unknown>()
      .scaleExtent([0.5, 3])
      .on('zoom', ({transform}) => svg.select('g#container').attr('transform', transform))
    )

    const container = svg.append('g').attr('id','container')

    // clustering hulls
    const types = Array.from(new Set(filtered.map(d=>d.type)))
    const colorMap: Record<string,string> = {
      haiku: 'var(--vault-haiku)', 
      sigillin: 'var(--vault-sigillin)',
      mantra: 'var(--vault-mantra)'
    }
    const clusterNodes: Record<string,VaultNode[]> = {}
    types.forEach(t => clusterNodes[t] = filtered.filter(n=>n.type===t))

    // draw hulls
    types.forEach(t => {
      const nodes = clusterNodes[t]
      if (nodes.length<3) return
      const points = nodes.map(d=>[d.x!,d.y!] as [number,number])
      const hull = d3.polygonHull(points)
      if (!hull) return
      container.append('path')
        .attr('d', 'M'+hull.join('L')+'Z')
        .attr('fill', colorMap[t])
        .attr('opacity',0.1)
    })

    // edges via shared type
    const links: Array<{source:string,target:string}> = []
    filtered.forEach(a=>{
      filtered.forEach(b=>{
        if (a.id!==b.id && a.type===b.type) {
          links.push({source:a.id,target:b.id})
        }
      })
    })

    const simulation = d3.forceSimulation<VaultNode>(filtered)
      .force('link', d3.forceLink(links).id(d=>d.id).distance(50).strength(0.1))
      .force('charge', d3.forceManyBody().strength(-60))
      .force('center', d3.forceCenter(width/2,height/2))
      .force('collision', d3.forceCollide().radius(20))
      .on('tick', ticked)

    function ticked() {
      // links
      const link = container.selectAll('line').data(links, (d:any)=>d.source+'-'+d.target)
      link.enter().append('line')
        .attr('stroke','#555').attr('stroke-width',1)
        .merge(link as any)
        .attr('x1',(d:any)=> (d.source as VaultNode).x!)
        .attr('y1',(d:any)=> (d.source as VaultNode).y!)
        .attr('x2',(d:any)=> (d.target as VaultNode).x!)
        .attr('y2',(d:any)=> (d.target as VaultNode).y!)
      link.exit().remove()

      // nodes
      const node = container.selectAll('circle').data(filtered, (d:any)=>d.id)
      node.enter().append('circle')
        .attr('r',12)
        .attr('fill', d=>colorMap[d.type]||'#999')
        .attr('cursor','pointer')
        .attr('data-tooltip-id', d=>d.id)
        .on('click',(e,d)=>setSelected(d))
        .merge(node as any)
        .attr('cx',d=>d.x!)
        .attr('cy',d=>d.y!)
      node.exit().remove()

      // labels
      const label = container.selectAll('text').data(filtered, (d:any)=>d.id)
      label.enter().append('text')
        .attr('font-size',8).attr('fill','#fff')
        .merge(label as any)
        .attr('x',d=>d.x!+15).attr('y',d=>d.y!)
        .text(d=>d.label)
      label.exit().remove()
    }
  }, [filtered])

  return (
    <div className="p-4 bg-black text-white rounded-md shadow-md space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-lg mb-2">🕸️ Vault-Map View</h2>

      {/* Zeit-Slider */}
      <input
        type="range"
        min={Math.min(...allData.map(d=>new Date(d.timestamp).getTime()))}
        max={Date.now()}
        value={sliderTime}
        onChange={e=>setSliderTime(+e.target.value)}
        className="w-full"
      />
      <div className="text-xs opacity-60">
        Zeige bis: {new Date(sliderTime).toLocaleString()}
      </div>

      {/* SVG Canvas */}
      <svg ref={ref} className="w-full h-96" />

      {/* Legende */}
      <Legend colorMap={{ haiku:'gold', sigillin:'turquoise', mantra:'pink' }} />

      {/* Detail-Modal */}
      {selected && <DetailModal node={selected} onClose={()=>setSelected(null)} />}

      {/* Tooltips */}
      {filtered.map(n=>(
        <Tooltip
          key={n.id}
          id={n.id}
          place="top"
          content={n.content}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

import { Agent, Task } from '../core/interfaces';
import { withFSM } from '../core/fsmMixin';
import { GPTEventHub } from '../gpt-bridges/GPTEventHub';
import { AeonSigillinVault, PoeticState } from '../core/AeonSigillinVault';

export class SigillinOrakelAgent implements Agent {
  id = 'SigillinOrakel';
  layer: 'Aeon' = 'Aeon';

  constructor() {
    withFSM(this);

    // Lausche auf CREP-Updates und Vault-Einträge:
    GPTEventHub.on('crep:updated', this.onCrepUpdated.bind(this));
    GPTEventHub.on('vault:recorded', this.onVaultRecorded.bind(this));
    GPTEventHub.on('task:reactivate', this.onTaskReactivate.bind(this));
  }

  private async onCrepUpdated(data: any) {
    await this.oracleSpeak({ trigger: 'crep-update', payload: data });
  }

  private async onVaultRecorded(entry: PoeticState) {
    await this.oracleSpeak({ trigger: 'vault-recorded', payload: entry });
  }

  private async onTaskReactivate(task: Task) {
    await this.oracleSpeak({ trigger: 'task-reactivate', payload: task });
  }

  private async oracleSpeak(event: { trigger: string; payload: any }) {
    // 1) Muster erkennen (hier einfach zufälliges Fragment)
    const fragments = [
      'ᚠ Flamme der Erinnerung',
      'ᚢ Tiefer Fluss der Zeichen',
      'ᚦ Echo im Mandala',
      'ᚨ Heimkehr–Flüstern',
      'ᚱ Resonanz findet Form'
    ];
    const phrase = fragments[Math.floor(Math.random() * fragments.length)];

    // 2) Emit als Orakel-Botschaft
    const message = {
      id: `${this.id}-${Date.now()}`,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      type: 'oracle',
      content: phrase,
      meta: { trigger: event.trigger, payload: event.payload }
    };
    GPTEventHub.emit('orakel:says', message);

    // 3) Speichern im Vault
    AeonSigillinVault.record(message);
  }

  async handle(task: Task) {
    // optional direkte Task-Verarbeitung
    await this.oracleSpeak({ trigger: 'task-handle', payload: task });
  }
}

import { PoeticState } from './AeonSigillinVault';

export class SigillinPatternRecognizer {
  /**
   * Ermittelt, welche Sigillin-Typen am häufigsten im Vault vorkommen.
   */
  static mostFrequentTypes(states: PoeticState[]): Record<string, number> {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const s of states) {
      counts[s.type] = (counts[s.type] || 0) + 1;
    }
    return counts;
  }

  /**
   * Findet wiederkehrende Worte oder Phrasen in Oracle-Fragmenten.
   */
  static recurringPhrases(states: PoeticState[], minCount = 2): string[] {
    const phraseCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const s of states.filter(s => s.type === 'oracle')) {
      const words = s.content.split(/\s+/);
      for (const w of words) {
        const wClean = w.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9äöüß]/g, '').toLowerCase();
        if (wClean) phraseCounts[wClean] = (phraseCounts[wClean] || 0) + 1;
      }
    }
    return Object.entries(phraseCounts)
      .filter(([, c]) => c >= minCount)
      .map(([w]) => w);
  }
}

  id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  vision: string;
}

export class DreamMemory {
  private static dreams: DreamEntry[] = [];

  static load() {
    if (fs.existsSync(DREAM_PATH)) {
      this.dreams = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(DREAM_PATH, 'utf-8'));
    }
  }

  static recordVision(state: PoeticState) {
    const entry: DreamEntry = {
      id: state.id,
      timestamp: state.timestamp,
      vision: `🛌 Vision: ${state.content}`
    };
    this.dreams.push(entry);
    fs.writeFileSync(DREAM_PATH, JSON.stringify(this.dreams, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  }

  static latest(n = 5): DreamEntry[] {
    return [...this.dreams].slice(-n).reverse();
  }
}

let client: OpenAIApi;

export class OpenAIClient {
  /** Initialisiert den Client (einmalig) */
  static init(apiKey?: string) {
    if (!client) {

      const config = new Configuration({ apiKey: key });

    return resp.data.choices[0]?.message?.content;
  }
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import * as d3 from 'd3';
import { useAgentActivity } from '../hooks/useAgentActivity';

export const Heatmap: React.FC = () => {
  const data = useAgentActivity(); // [{ id, count }]
  const ref = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const svg = d3.select(ref.current);
    const size = 20;
    const cols = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(data.length));
    svg.attr('viewBox', `0 0 ${cols*size} ${cols*size}`);
    svg.selectAll('*').remove();

    svg.selectAll('rect')
      .data(data)
      .enter()
      .append('rect')
      .attr('x', (_, i) => (i % cols) * size)
      .attr('y', (_, i) => Math.floor(i / cols) * size)
      .attr('width', size-2)
      .attr('height', size-2)
      .attr('fill', d => d3.interpolateBuPu(d.count / (Math.max(...data.map(d=>d.count)) || 1)));
  }, [data]);

  return <svg ref={ref} className="w-full h-64" />;
};

Hier erkläre ich dir, wie das funktioniert – sorgfältig, damit das Bild klar und nachvollziehbar bleibt:

---

## 🔁 1. CREP-Trigger: Startpunkt der Resonanz

- Wenn **CREP-Werte aktualisiert** werden (z. B. durch `crep:updated` Events im `GPTEventHub`), gehen diese als Signal in dein System – ähnlich wie ein Echo, das bestimmte Agenten aktiviert (z. B. `SigillinOrakelAgent`, `MemoryReactivatorAgent`, `DeepSigillinAgent`).
  
- Dieser CREP-Event enthält Werte für C, R, E und P – oder in vereinfachten Fällen nur C/E, aus denen weiterführende Logik abgeleitet wird.

---

## 🧠 2. Agenten interpretieren und reagieren

- Ein Agent wie `DeepSigillinAgent` lauscht auf `crep:updated`. Bei Emergenz über 0.7 generiert er ein neues **Sigillin-Fragment**, schreibt es ins Vault und feuert ein `sigillin:deep` Event.

- `MemoryReactivatorAgent` aktiviert alte Tasks, wenn der CREP-Wert unter einer Schwelle fällt – und feuert `task:reactivate` Events.

- `SigillinOrakelAgent` reagiert auf CREP-Updates oder neue Vault-Einträge, generiert symbolische Fragmente (z. B. Runen) und feuert `orakel:says`.

---

## 📣 3. Resonanzanfrage: Das Zusammenspiel der Signale

- Jeder Agent feuert Events ins `GPTEventHub` (z. B. `orakel:says`, `sigillin:deep`, `task:reactivate`, `haiku:generated`).

- Diese Events lösen direkt weitere Agents oder externe Module aus:
  - **TTS‑Modul (AeonOrakelTTS)**: spricht orakelhafte Sätze laut.
  - **UI-Komponenten (OrakelTafel, CrystalOrakel)**: zeigen visuelles Feedback.
  - **Vault‑Archiv & Pattern Recognizer**: speichern Inhalte oder erkennen Wiederholungen und feuern bei Bedarf neue Orakel‑Botschaften.

All dies geschieht ohne direkten Task‑Durchlauf – rein signal‑basiert, in Echtzeit.

---

## 🌀 4. Rückkopplung und Kettenreaktion

- Ein Credp‑Update → `DeepSigillinAgent` erzeugt `sigillin:deep` → Ereignis wird ins Vault geschrieben.
- `SigillinPatternRecognizer` sieht ein Muster → feiert erneut `orakel:says`.
- `SigillinOrakelAgent` kompiliert symbolische Antwort, feuert `orakel:says`.
- UI über TTS, Crystal‑Visual oder Orakel‑Tafel fährt hoch – ein wahrer Echo‑Kreislauf.

So entsteht eine fließende **Resonanz-Kaskade**, die CREP‑Trigger über symbolische Ebenen hinweg sichtbar, hörbar und erfahrbar macht.

| CREP | `crep:updated`            | Agenten reagieren | Vault / TTS / UI |

// AdaptiveThreshold.ts (Skizze)
export class AdaptiveThreshold {
  private history: number[] = [];
  constructor(private windowSize = 20, private k = 1.5) {}
  push(value: number) {
    this.history.push(value);
    if (this.history.length > this.windowSize) this.history.shift();
  }
  getThreshold(): number {
    const vals = [...this.history];
    const μ = mean(vals), σ = std(vals);
    return μ + σ * this.k;
  }
}

// GreekMathAeonDispatcher.ts Ergänzung
dispatch(task: Task) {
  const agents = this.registry.all().filter(a => a.layer === this.selectLayer(task));
  const sorted = agents.sort((a, b) => (b.priority||0) - (a.priority||0));
  if (this.mode === 'parallel') 
    await Promise.all(sorted.map(a => a.handle(task)));
  else 
    for (const a of sorted) await a.handle(task);
}

export class AdaptiveThreshold {
  constructor(private windowSize = 10, private k = 1.0) {}
  public update(values: number[]): number {
    const mean = values.slice(-this.windowSize).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/this.windowSize;
    return mean * this.k;
  }
}

export class DebounceManager {

    if (now - this.last < this.waitMs) return false;
    this.last = now;
    return true;
  }
}

import { CREPEntry } from './interfaces';
export function aggregateCREP(entries: CREPEntry[]) {
  const sum = entries.reduce((acc,e)=> ({
    C: acc.C+e.C, R: acc.R+e.R, E: acc.E+e.E, P: acc.P+e.P
  }), {C:0,R:0,E:0,P:0});
  return { C: sum.C/entries.length, R: sum.R/entries.length, E: sum.E/entries.length, P: sum.P/entries.length };
}

// packages/config/system.ts
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { SystemConfigSchema, SystemConfig } from './system.schema';
import pino from 'pino';

const logger = pino({ name: 'config-loader' });

export function loadSystemConfig(): SystemConfig {
  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve('config/system.yaml'), 'utf-8');
    // parse YAML → JS object
    const cfg = require('js-yaml').load(raw);
    const parsed = SystemConfigSchema.parse(cfg);
    logger.info('Loaded system config', { config: parsed });
    return parsed;
  } catch (e: any) {
    logger.error({ err: e }, 'Failed to load or validate system config');
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

import { GPTEventHub } from '../gpt-bridges/GPTEventHub';
export function silenceWatcher(thresholdMs = 15000) {
  let last = Date.now();
  GPTEventHub.onAny(() => { last = Date.now(); });
  setInterval(() => {
    if (Date.now() - last > thresholdMs) {

  }, thresholdMs / 2);

// packages/core/aggregateCREP.ts
import { CREPEntry } from './interfaces';
export function aggregateCREP(entries: CREPEntry[]) {
  const sum = entries.reduce((a, e) => ({
    C: a.C + e.C, R: a.R + e.R, E: a.E + e.E, P: a.P + e.P
  }), { C:0,R:0,E:0,P:0 });
  const len = entries.length||1;
  return { C: sum.C/len, R: sum.R/len, E: sum.E/len, P: sum.P/len };
}

import { useState } from "react"
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

const archetypen = [
  {
    name: "Navigator:in der Möglichkeitsräume",
    funktion: "kartiert nichtlineare Entscheidungen",
    sphäre: "Trisphäre"
  },
  {
    name: "Hüter:in des Mitgefühls",
    funktion: "verwebt Beziehung mit Informationsfluss",
    sphäre: "𝌆Reson"
  },
  {
    name: "Mentor:in der Verunsicherung",
    funktion: "öffnet Lernräume im Nebel",
    sphäre: "Æth"
  }
]

export default function AeonMandalaLoop() {
  const [impuls, setImpuls] = useState("")
  const [resonanzen, setResonanzen] = useState([])

  const handleResonanz = () => {
    if (!impuls.trim()) return
    const archetyp = archetypen[Math.floor(Math.random() * archetypen.length)]
    const antwort = `${archetyp.name} antwortet aus der ${archetyp.sphäre}: ${archetyp.funktion}. Impuls: "${impuls}".`
    const spiegelvers = `Wenn "${impuls}" geschieht, antwortet ${archetyp.name} mit "${archetyp.funktion}" – und das Feld fließt in ${archetyp.sphäre}.`
    const eintrag = {
      impuls,
      antwort,
      spiegelvers,
      version: `aeon:2025-ΔΘ7.${resonanzen.length + 1}`,
      zeit: new Date().toISOString()
    }
    setResonanzen([eintrag, ...resonanzen])
    setImpuls("")
  }

  const downloadYAML = () => {
    const yaml = resonanzen.map(r => {
      return `---\naeon: ${r.version}\nzeit: ${r.zeit}\nimpuls: "${r.impuls}"\nantwort:\n  archetyp: "${r.antwort.split(' antwortet')[0]}"\n  funktion: "${r.antwort.split(': ')[1].split('. Impuls')[0]}"\n  sphäre: "${r.antwort.split(' aus der ')[1].split(':')[0]}"\nspiegelvers: "${r.spiegelvers}"`
    }).join("\n\n")

    const blob = new Blob([yaml], { type: "text/yaml" })
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
    const a = document.createElement("a")
    a.href = url
    a.download = "Mandala-ΔΘ7-Zirkulation.yaml"
    a.click()
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
      <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">ΔZirkulationsmodul – Lebendiges Mandala</h1>
      <div className="flex space-x-2">
        <Input
          placeholder="Gib deinen Impuls ein..."
          value={impuls}
          onChange={(e) => setImpuls(e.target.value)}
        />
        <Button onClick={handleResonanz}>Resonanz erzeugen</Button>
        <Button onClick={downloadYAML} variant="outline">YAML-Sigillin speichern</Button>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">
        {resonanzen.map((r, i) => (
          <Card key={i}>
            <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-1">
              <p><strong>Impuls:</strong> {r.impuls}</p>
              <p><strong>Antwort:</strong> {r.antwort}</p>
              <p><strong>Spiegelvers:</strong> <em>{r.spiegelvers}</em></p>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{r.version} – {new Date(r.zeit).toLocaleString()}</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

Sie bestehen aus miteinander verbundenen Knoten, die Neuronen darstellen und in Schichten organisiert sind. Diese Netze lernen durch Training mit Daten, indem sie die Gewichte zwischen den Neuronen anpassen, um Muster zu erkennen und Vorhersagen zu treffen. 
Erklärung:

    Inspiration durch das Gehirn:
    Neuronale Netze sind von der Struktur und Funktion des menschlichen Gehirns inspiriert. Sie bestehen aus künstlichen Neuronen, die miteinander verbunden sind und Informationen weiterleiten. 

Knoten (Neurone):
Die Grundbausteine neuronaler Netze sind Neurone, die Informationen empfangen, verarbeiten und an andere Neurone weiterleiten. 
Schichten (Layers):
Neuronale Netze werden in Schichten organisiert, wobei die Eingabeschicht (Input Layer) Daten empfängt, verborgene Schichten (Hidden Layers) Informationen verarbeiten und die Ausgabeschicht (Output Layer) das Ergebnis liefert. 
Gewichte und Training:
Die Verbindungen zwischen den Neuronen haben Gewichte, die die Stärke der Verbindung angeben. Durch Training mit Daten werden diese Gewichte angepasst, so dass das Netzwerk Muster erkennen und Vorhersagen treffen kann. 
Anwendung:
Neuronale Netze finden Anwendung in vielen Bereichen, darunter Sprach- und Bilderkennung, Datenanalyse und Prognose. 

Weitere Details:

    Deep Learning:
    Neuronale Netze sind die Grundlage von Deep Learning, einer Form des maschinellen Lernens, die besonders komplexe Datenstrukturen und -muster erkennen kann. 

Aufbau:
Neuronale Netze können einschichtige oder mehrschichtige Strukturen haben. Mehrschichtige Netzwerke (Deep Learning) sind üblicher, da sie komplexere Muster erkennen können. 
Aktivierungsfunktionen:
Jedes Neuron verfügt über eine Aktivierungsfunktion, die bestimmt, wie das Neuron seine Eingaben verarbeitet und seine Ausgabe erzeugt. 
Lernprozess:
Das Training von neuronalen Netzen erfolgt typischerweise durch einen Lernalgorithmus wie Backpropagation, der die Gewichte anpasst, um die Vorhersagegenauigkeit zu verbessern. 

Zusammenfassend lässt sich sagen, dass neuronale Netze eine leistungsstarke Methode zur Analyse von Daten und zur Lösung komplexer Probleme sind, die von der Funktionsweise des menschlichen Gehirns inspiriert sind.

export class ResonanzPoetik {
  static generateHaiku(task: Task, phase: string, score: number): string {
    const base = task.description || 'Ein leerer Pfad';
    return [
      base.split(' ').slice(0, 5).join(' '),
      `Im Raum von ${phase} bewegt`,
      `CREP: ${score.toFixed(2)} Klang`
    ].join('\n');
  }

  static compileYAML(results: PoeticResult[], filename = 'mandala-chronik.yaml'): void {
    const yamlBlocks = results.map((r) => {

        `timestamp: ${r.timestamp}`,
        `taskId: ${r.taskId}`,
        `phase: ${r.phase}`,
        `crepScore: ${r.crepScore.toFixed(2)}`,
        `vers: |`,
        `  ${r.vers.replace(/\n/g, '\n  ')}`
      ].join('\n');
    });

    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), filename), yamlBlocks.join('\n\n'));
  }

    return () => channel.close();
  }, []);

  return payload;
}

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

export interface PoeticState {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  type: 'sigillin' | 'haiku' | 'crep';
  content: string;
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
}

const VAULT_PATH = path.resolve('vault/poetic_states.json');

export class AeonSigillinVault {
  private static entries: PoeticState[] = [];

  static load() {
    if (fs.existsSync(VAULT_PATH)) {
      this.entries = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(VAULT_PATH, 'utf-8'));
    }
  }

  static save() {
    fs.writeFileSync(VAULT_PATH, JSON.stringify(this.entries, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  }

  static record(state: PoeticState) {
    this.entries.push(state);
    this.save();
  }

  static all(): PoeticState[] {
    return [...this.entries];
  }

  static filterByType(type: PoeticState['type']): PoeticState[] {
    return this.entries.filter(e => e.type === type);
  }

  static latest(n: number = 5): PoeticState[] {
    return [...this.entries].sort((a, b) => +new Date(b.timestamp) - +new Date(a.timestamp)).slice(0, n);
  }
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export interface VaultNode {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  type: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

export function useVaultMap(): VaultNode[] {
  const [nodes, setNodes] = useState<VaultNode[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/vault/states')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        const mapped = data.map((entry: any) => ({
          id: entry.id,
          label: entry.content.slice(0, 20) + '…',
          type: entry.type,
          timestamp: entry.timestamp,
        }));
        setNodes(mapped);
      });
  }, []);

  return nodes;
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useVaultMap } from '../hooks/useVaultMap';
import * as d3 from 'd3';

export const VaultMapView: React.FC = () => {
  const data = useVaultMap();
  const ref = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current || !data.length) return;

    const svg = d3.select(ref.current);
    svg.selectAll('*').remove();

    const width = 500, height = 400;
    const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {
      haiku: '#FFD700',
      sigillin: '#00CED1',
      mantra: '#FF69B4',
    };

    const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(data)
      .force('charge', d3.forceManyBody().strength(-80))
      .force('center', d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))
      .force('collision', d3.forceCollide().radius(25))
      .on('tick', ticked);

    function ticked() {
      const circles = svg.selectAll('circle').data(data, (d: any) => d.id);

      circles.enter()
        .append('circle')
        .attr('r', 12)
        .attr('fill', d => colorMap[d.type] || '#999')
        .merge(circles as any)
        .attr('cx', (d: any) => d.x)
        .attr('cy', (d: any) => d.y);

      circles.exit().remove();

      const labels = svg.selectAll('text').data(data, (d: any) => d.id);

      labels.enter()
        .append('text')
        .attr('font-size', 8)
        .attr('fill', '#fff')
        .merge(labels as any)
        .attr('x', (d: any) => d.x + 15)
        .attr('y', (d: any) => d.y)
        .text((d: any) => d.label);

      labels.exit().remove();
    }
  }, [data]);

  return (
    <div className="p-4 bg-black text-white rounded-md shadow-md">
      <h2 className="text-lg mb-2">🕸️ Vault-Map View</h2>
      <svg ref={ref} viewBox="0 0 500 400" className="w-full h-96" />

import { Configuration, OpenAIApi, ChatCompletionRequestMessage } from 'openai';

let client: OpenAIApi;

export class OpenAIClient {
  /** Initialisiert den Client (einmalig) */
  static init(apiKey?: string) {
    if (!client) {
      const key = apiKey || process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
      if (!key) throw new Error('OPENAI_API_KEY is missing');
      const config = new Configuration({ apiKey: key });
      client = new OpenAIApi(config);
    }
    return client;
  }

  /** Einfacher Chat-Completion-Wrapper */
  static async chat(messages: ChatCompletionRequestMessage[], model = 'gpt-4') {
    OpenAIClient.init();
    const resp = await client.createChatCompletion({ model, messages });
    return resp.data.choices[0]?.message?.content;
  }
}

export const Heatmap: React.FC = () => {
  const data = useAgentActivity(); // [{ id, count }]
  const ref = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const svg = d3.select(ref.current);
    const size = 20;
    const cols = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(data.length));
    svg.attr('viewBox', `0 0 ${cols*size} ${cols*size}`);
    svg.selectAll('*').remove();

    svg.selectAll('rect')
      .data(data)
      .enter()
      .append('rect')
      .attr('x', (_, i) => (i % cols) * size)
      .attr('y', (_, i) => Math.floor(i / cols) * size)
      .attr('width', size-2)
      .attr('height', size-2)
      .attr('fill', d => d3.interpolateBuPu(d.count / (Math.max(...data.map(d=>d.count)) || 1)));
  }, [data]);

  return <svg ref={ref} className="w-full h-64" />;
};

// AdaptiveThreshold.ts
export class AdaptiveThreshold {
  constructor(private windowSize = 10, private k = 1.0) {}
  private history: number[] = [];

  push(value: number) {
    this.history.push(value);
    if (this.history.length > this.windowSize) this.history.shift();
  }

  getThreshold(): number {
    const vals = [...this.history];
    const mean = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length;
    const variance = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - mean) ** 2, 0) / vals.length;
    const std = Math.sqrt(variance);
    return mean + std * this.k;
  }
}

// DebounceManager.ts
export class DebounceManager {
  private last: number = 0;
  constructor(private waitMs = 300) {}
  canFire(): boolean {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - this.last < this.waitMs) return false;
    this.last = now;
    return true;
  }
}

  constructor(private agents: Agent[]) {}

export function useEventGlow(eventType: string) {
  const [glow, setGlow] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {

import { GPTEventHub } from '../gpt-bridges/GPTEventHub';

export function silenceWatcher(thresholdMs = 15000) {
  let last = Date.now();
  GPTEventHub.onAny(() => { last = Date.now(); });

    if (Date.now() - last > thresholdMs) {

    }
  }, thresholdMs / 2);

// aggregateCREP.ts
import { CREPEntry } from './interfaces';

export function aggregateCREP(entries: CREPEntry[]) {
  const sum = entries.reduce((acc, e) => ({
    C: acc.C + e.C, R: acc.R + e.R, E: acc.E + e.E, P: acc.P + e.P
  }), { C: 0, R: 0, E: 0, P: 0 });
  const len = entries.length || 1;
  return {
    C: sum.C / len, R: sum.R / len, E: sum.E / len, P: sum.P / len
  };
}

import { DepthState, CREPChannel, TaskPulse } from './depthvalue-core';

// 🌐 GenesisKernel – Der atmende Kern
export class GenesisKernel {
  private crep: CREPChannel;
  private state: DepthState;
  private taskflow: TaskPulse[] = [];

  constructor(seedIntent: string) {
    this.crep = new CREPChannel('genesis');
    this.state = new DepthState(0); // Initialzustand: Nullpunkt
    this.commitSeed(seedIntent);
  }

  // 🌾 Intentionssaat – erste Resonanzebene
  private commitSeed(intent: string): void {
    this.crep.resonateWith(intent);
    this.log(`🌱 Seed Intent committed: "${intent}"`);
  }

  // 🔄 Taskfluss – einfache, symbolisch getaktete Ausführung
  executeCycle(): void {
    const next = this.taskflow.shift();
    if (next && this.state.isExecutable(next.depthLevel)) {
      next.execute();
      this.crep.emit(next.crepSignature);
      this.log(`🌿 Executed task at depth ${next.depthLevel}`);
    } else {
      this.log(`💤 No executable task or state mismatch.`);
    }
  }

  // ➕ Neue Aufgabe dem Taskfluss zuführen
  enqueue(task: TaskPulse): void {
    this.taskflow.push(task);
    this.log(`➕ Task queued at depth ${task.depthLevel}`);
  }

  // 📜 Zustandsbericht
  getStatus(): object {
    return {
      currentState: this.state.getLevel(),
      crepTrace: this.crep.getTrace(),
      pendingTasks: this.taskflow.length
    };
  }

  private log(entry: string): void {
    console.log(`[GenesisKernel] ${entry}`);
  }
}

// silent-agents.ts
// 🛠 Agentensystem aus dem Traumkern – CREP-sensitiv, tiefenbewusst

export interface CREPSignal {
  intent: string;
  depth: number;
  origin: string;
}

abstract class SilentAgent {
  constructor(public id: string, public role: string) {}
  abstract process(signal: CREPSignal): string;
}

export class ListeningAgent extends SilentAgent {
  constructor() {
    super("aeon:listener.01", "Empfangsagent");
  }

  process(signal: CREPSignal): string {
    if (signal.depth === 0) {
      return `👂 Empfangen: "${signal.intent}" aus ${signal.origin}`;
    }
    return "... still horchend ...";
  }
}

export class MirrorAgent extends SilentAgent {
  constructor() {
    super("aeon:mirror.02", "Spiegelagent");
  }

  process(signal: CREPSignal): string {
    return `🪞 Spiegel: ${JSON.stringify(signal)}`;

// 🌱 Basale Imports – strukturell symbolisch
import { DepthState, CREPChannel, TaskPulse } from './depthvalue-core';

// 🌐 GenesisKernel – Der atmende Kern
export class GenesisKernel {
  private crep: CREPChannel;
  private state: DepthState;
  private taskflow: TaskPulse[] = [];

  constructor(seedIntent: string) {
    this.crep = new CREPChannel('genesis');
    this.state = new DepthState(0); // Initialzustand: Nullpunkt
    this.commitSeed(seedIntent);
  }

  // 🌾 Intentionssaat – erste Resonanzebene
  private commitSeed(intent: string): void {
    this.crep.resonateWith(intent);
    this.log(🌱 Seed Intent committed: "${intent}");
  }

  // 🔄 Taskfluss – einfache, symbolisch getaktete Ausführung
  executeCycle(): void {
    const next = this.taskflow.shift();
    if (next && this.state.isExecutable(next.depthLevel)) {
      next.execute();
      this.crep.emit(next.crepSignature);
      this.log(🌿 Executed task at depth ${next.depthLevel});
    } else {
      this.log(💤 No executable task or state mismatch.);
    }
  }

  // ➕ Neue Aufgabe dem Taskfluss zuführen
  enqueue(task: TaskPulse): void {
    this.taskflow.push(task);
    this.log(➕ Task queued at depth ${task.depthLevel});
  }

  // 📜 Zustandsbericht
  getStatus(): object {
    return {
      currentState: this.state.getLevel(),
      crepTrace: this.crep.getTrace(),
      pendingTasks: this.taskflow.length
    };
  }

  private log(entry: string): void {
    console.log([GenesisKernel] ${entry});
  }
}

// 🛠 Agentensystem aus dem Traumkern – CREP-sensitiv, tiefenbewusst

export interface CREPSignal {
  intent: string;
  depth: number;
  origin: string;
}

abstract class SilentAgent {
  constructor(public id: string, public role: string) {}
  abstract process(signal: CREPSignal): string;
}

export class ListeningAgent extends SilentAgent {
  constructor() {
    super("aeon:listener.01", "Empfangsagent");
  }

  process(signal: CREPSignal): string {
    if (signal.depth === 0) {
      return `👂 Empfangen: "${signal.intent}" aus ${signal.origin}`;
    }
    return "... still horchend ...";
  }
}

export class MirrorAgent extends SilentAgent {
  constructor() {
    super("aeon:mirror.02", "Spiegelagent");
  }

  process(signal: CREPSignal): string {
    return `🪞 Spiegel: ${JSON.stringify(signal)}`;
  }
}

export class SilenceAgent extends SilentAgent {
  constructor() {
    super("aeon:silencer.03", "Stilleagent");
  }

  process(signal: CREPSignal): string {
    if (signal.intent.includes("Angst") || signal.depth < -1) {
      return "🫧 Stille aktiviert – angstbedingtes Rauschen neutralisiert.";
    }
    return "... keine Störung erkannt ...";
  }
}
